Lina (CS Ops): Heads-up — I prototyped a tiny admin CLI to surface "stale health" accounts + run a dry-run patch that marks accounts for manual review. Wanted to share before I start a bigger rollout.
Arjun (Eng): Nice. Can you paste the commands?
Lina (CS Ops): Sure — current flow is `cs-admin scan --since 90d --min-activity 1` then `cs-admin flag --dry-run --tag stale_onboard` . Quick example:```
# list candidates
cs-admin scan --since 90d --min-activity 1 --output csv > candidates.csv
# dry-run apply recommended tag (no writes)
cs-admin flag --file candidates.csv --dry-run --tag stale_onboard
```
Maya (Product): Love the quick CLI. What heuristics are you using to call something "stale"?
Lina (CS Ops): It's a blend: last_user_activity, onboarding_progress < 40%, no logged-in sessions in last 30d, and poor telemetry pings (low event rate). We score and threshold at 0.6 for now.
Nate (CS Manager): Two asks — 1) show a reason field per account so CSMs see why it was flagged, 2) produce an audit_id that links to the playbook run.
Lina (CS Ops): Yep. CLI already writes audit_id and reason. Sample CSV columns: account_id,score,reason,audit_id. Also stores a backup snapshot in S3: `s3://redwood-cs/audit/1898765432/`.
Arjun (Eng): Implementation Q: will this call the playbook-runner API or patch CRM directly? We should avoid direct writes from the CLI in prod.
Lina (CS Ops): Good point — current plan: default to playbook-runner API (creates tasks for CS agents). Direct CRM writes behind a `--force` flag and restricted service account.
Maya (Product): Can we gate by confidence band? e.g., only enqueue to playbook-runner if score >= 0.75, otherwise drop into a low-priority sampling queue for manual review.
Lina (CS Ops): Yep — config options: `--enqueue-threshold 0.75` and `--sample-rate 0.05`. Planning a soft rollout to CS alpha group.
playbook-bot: scheduled-playbook-run 1898765400 completed: 124 candidates evaluated, 30 qualified for enqueue (threshold 0.75), sample 6 picked.
Nate (CS Manager): For rollout: can you add a per-owner opt-out and an email summary template? CSMs will need an easy way to say "not this week".
Lina (CS Ops): Adding owner_opt_out list and `--notify-template path/to/template.md`. Will do.
Arjun (Eng): One more — include a `--dry-run-report` that spits a JSON diff we can feed into the telemetry eval pipeline.
Lina (CS Ops): Adding `--dry-run-report json` — good call.
Maya (Product): Timeline? Roughly: alpha for 1 week, then beta to whole team. Also we should add metric tracking: false positive rate, manual override rate, and downstream renewal delta.
Lina (CS Ops): Plan: alpha tomorrow morning with 3 owners, beta in two sprints if no major issues. I'll post the alpha results in #customer-success and attach the audit S3 link.
Nate (CS Manager): Thanks — please tag me when you switch to enqueue. :thumbsup:
Lina (CS Ops): Will do. If anyone wants early access to the CLI binary, ping me and I'll share the exec and a quick runbook.
Arjun (Eng): Can you drop a short README in the repo (cs-admin/README.md) — include safety checklist: service account, rate limit, dry-run before write.
Lina (CS Ops): Yep adding README now.
Maya (Product): Also add a field in the CSV for renewal_period_weeks — helps prioritize.
Lina (CS Ops): Good idea — adding that.
playbook-bot: playbook-runner enqueue 1898765488 created 30 tasks (alpha queue).
Lina (CS Ops): alpha started — will update after 24h with noise stats. Thanks team!
